scheme_name: Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme (Tax Dispute Resolution)
overview: The Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme (Tax Dispute Resolution) was launched to reduce litigation and provide a mechanism for settlement of pending tax disputes. It allows taxpayers to settle disputed tax, It allows taxpayers to settle disputed tax, settle disputed tax, interest, and penalty by paying a specified amount, thereby avoiding prolonged litigation. The scheme aims to provide certainty and reduce the burden on the tax administration and taxpayers.
objectives: Enable faster resolution of tax disputes
eligibility: Taxpayers having pending tax demands before any appellate forum as on a specified cutoff date are eligible to opt for the scheme.
benefits: Waiver of interest and penalty on payment of disputed tax amount; immunity from prosecution and penalty under certain provisions; withdrawal of pending appeals, revisions, references; no further proceedings under the Income-tax Act after settlement.
financial_support: Taxpayers pay a percentage of the disputed tax amount as settlement amount, with reduced rates if paid without interest; no interest or penalty is charged on the settlement amount if paid within the specified time.
application_process: 1. Eligible taxpayer identifies pending tax disputes as on cutoff date. 2. Computes settlement amount as per scheme provisions. 3. Files declaration in prescribed form online. 4. Pays the settlement amount. 5. Receives certificate of settlement and withdrawal of pending proceedings.
deadlines: The scheme was open for a limited window; currently closed as per evidence.
implementing_agency: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
caveats: Scheme window has closed; no further applications accepted
Settlement amount is final and cannot be refunded
Does not cover disputes related to prosecution already launched
